item.title: c++react
item.description:
The last few days I built a small library, and I want to write down why.

I am working on a game in Unreal Engine 5, in C++. At some point you need a user interface, and if you have ever built one in C++ around OpenGL, you know the options are thin. I come from the web, I am used to React and CSS, and I missed them more than I expected. I tried a few things and none of them felt right.
